_about: Heat pump: electricity in, heat out, sized in kW of heat. Without a data center its heat source is the outside air (air-source, scenario S2). TO CHECK: the COP values are placeholders until sourced values are given.
supply_temp_note: temperature of the heat given to the greenhouse, °C (assumption of the thesis: 60 °C heating water)

cop.mode_note: constant: cop.nominal all year; dynamic: from the outside temperature of the block's input file, COP_t = nominal x (supply_temp_c - ref_outside_temp_c) / (supply_temp_c - outside temperature_t)
cop.nominal_note: COP (kWh of heat per kWh of electricity) at the reference outside temperature and the supply temperature. TO CHECK: placeholder
cop.ref_outside_temp_note: outside temperature at which the COP is cop.nominal, °C. TO CHECK: placeholder
